data.name: Claude Code AI Tool Accidentally Exposes Thousands of Developer Secrets on GitHub
data.summary: When users check 'Yes, and don’t ask again' for shell commands in Claude Code, it saves credentials directly into a .claude/settings.local.json file that sometimes gets committed to GitHub. Security firm Apiiro found 1,379 secrets in 1,122 public repos, with a deeper scan uncovering 2,539 across 1,994 repositories. Anthropic acknowledged the issue and is adding secret scanning, while developers are urged to check their repos, rotate exposed keys, add the file to .gitignore, and scrub git history.
data.hook: Developers rely on AI tools like Anthropic's Claude Code to speed up work, but a simple settings choice has leaked real passwords and API keys into public repos.
